story.p1: I-{{full}} yaqala ngomzuzu wokuziqhenya. U-{{founder}} wabona abangane bakhe abaseduze beqala izinkampani zabo, futhi wazibonela ukuthi kudinga isibindi esingakanani ukuqala.
story.p2: Lowo mzuzu wahlala kuye. Sekuyisikhathi eside enothando lokusiza ama-SMME afinyelele imigomo yawo, athuthuke futhi akhule, futhi wayefuna ukwakha into ezoma nawo ngenkathi enza lokho.
story.p3: Igama lingumlayezo ayefuna ukuwuthumela kubangane bakhe abaseduze, nakuwo wonke amabhizinisi nezinhlangano eziyisebenzisayo: niyakwazi. Qhubekani nilwela phambili, ningaze niyeke.
story.title: Indaba yethu

about.tagline: I-CRM ehlanganisa ibhizinisi lakho, amakhasimende akho nethimba lakho.

hero.body: Ukuqhuba ibhizinisi kudinga isibindi, ukuzimisela nokusebenza kanzima. Ukuliphatha akufanele kwenze uhambo lube nzima kakhulu. Sakha amathuluzi alula, acacile ukuze ugxile kokubalulekile: ukwakha into enenjongo.

mission.title: Umgomo wethu
mission.body: Ukunika amabhizinisi ubuchwepheshe obufinyelelekayo, obuthembekile nobuhlakaniphile obenza umsebenzi ube lula, bukhulise ukukhiqiza futhi busekele ukukhula okuhlala njalo.

vision.title: Umbono wethu
vision.body: Ukuba ngumlingani wobuchwepheshe othembekile wamabhizinisi kulo lonke elaseNingizimu Afrika nangale, sisiza osomabhizinisi baguqule amaphupho abe ngamabhizinisi ahlala njalo.

grow.title: Khula
grow.body: Yakha ubudlelwano obuqinile namakhasimende, uthole amathuba amasha futhi uqhubekisele phambili ukuthengisa ngokubuka okucacile kwepayipi lakho.

manage.title: Phatha
manage.body: Gcina umsebenzi wakho wansuku zonke ndawonye: amakhasimende, izilinganiso, ama-invoyisi, imikhiqizo, imisebenzi nemilayezo.

succeed.title: Phumelela
succeed.body: Hlala wazi, wenze izinqumo ezingcono futhi uqhubeke uya emigomweni yakho. Impumelelo ihlukile ebhizinisini ngalinye; i-YGT ikusiza ugxile kweyakho.

builtFor.title: Yakhelwe amabhizinisi abo bonke osayizi
builtFor.body: Noma uqala ibhizinisi lakho lokuqala, uphethe inkampani ekhulayo noma uhola ithimba elikhulu, i-YGT yakhelwe ukusekela uhambo lwakho. Amathuluzi anamandla ebhizinisi kufanele asebenziseke futhi afinyeleleke, angagcinelwa izinhlangano ezinkulu kuphela.

simplicity.title: Ubulula
simplicity.body: Ubuchwepheshe kufanele benze impilo ibe lula.

accessibility.title: Ukufinyeleleka
accessibility.body: Amathuluzi ebhizinisi awusizo kufanele afinyeleleke kuwo wonke umuntu.

innovation.title: Ukusungula

empowerment.title: Ukunika amandla
empowerment.body: Sisiza osomabhizinisi benze izinto ngokuzethemba futhi baqhubeke bekhula.

sa.title: INingizimu Afrika engcono, eqinile

smsSteps.account: Vula i-akhawunti ku-BulkSMS, Clickatell noma Twilio bese uthenga ikhredithi.
smsSteps.keys: Dala okhiye be-API kudeshibhodi yomhlinzeki bese ubanamathisela ngezansi.
smsSteps.sender: Engeza i-ID yomthumeli noma inombolo evunyelwe ngumhlinzeki wakho (amanethiwekhi amaningi aseNingizimu Afrika adinga i-ID yomthumeli ebhalisiwe).

webhookHelp.sms: Kudeshibhodi yomhlinzeki wakho we-SMS, setha leli njengekheli lemilayezo engenayo (inbound / reply webhook) ukuze izimpendulo zifike ku-YGT.
webhookHelp.whatsapp: Namathisela lokhu ku-Meta: WhatsApp > Configuration > Webhook, bese ubhalisela "messages". Yile ndlela izimpendulo zamakhasimende ezifika ngayo ku-YGT.

channels.whatsappIntro: Xhuma inombolo yakho ye-WhatsApp Business nge-Cloud API esemthethweni ye-Meta. Imilayezo iphuma enombolweni yakho futhi izimpendulo zingena kuMilayezo.

whatsappSteps.app: Iya ku-developers.facebook.com, dala i-app yohlobo lwe-Business bese wengeza umkhiqizo we-WhatsApp.
whatsappSteps.ids: Ngaphansi kwe-WhatsApp > API Setup, engeza inombolo yocingo yebhizinisi lakho bese ukopisha i-Phone number ID ne-WhatsApp Business Account ID.
whatsappSteps.save: Namathisela ngezansi, khetha "Sebenzisa i-WhatsApp", londoloza, bese uhlola ngenombolo yakho yeselula.
whatsappSteps.token: Ku-Business Settings > System users, dala i-access token ehlala njalo enemvume ye-whatsapp_business_messaging.
whatsappSteps.webhook: Kopisha i-webhook URL ne-verify token okuboniswa emva kokulondoloza kuzilungiselelo ze-webhook ze-Meta.
whatsappSteps.window: Umthetho we-WhatsApp: ungaphendula ngokukhululeka amahora angu-24 emva kokuba ikhasimende likuthumelele umlayezo; ukuqala ingxoxo emva kwalokho kudinga i-template evunyelwe yi-Meta.

customers.problem: Imininingwane yamakhasimende akho isakazeke ku-{{tools}}, ngakho ukuthola inombolo efanele noma umlando kuthatha isikhathi.
customers.fix: Uhlu olulodwa lwamakhasimende olunabo bonke oxhumana nabo, izilinganiso, ama-invoyisi nezingxoxo, ithimba lakho lonke elingasesha kulo.

problem.memory: Imibuzo yamakhasimende ihlala ekhanda lakho, ngakho uma kumatasa, eminye iyabanda ngaphambi kokuba kulandelelwe.
problem.whatsapp: Imibuzo ingcwatshwe ezingxoxweni ze-WhatsApp, ngakho kunzima ukubona okulindile noma ukuthi ngamunye ubaluleke kangakanani.
problem.excel: Imibuzo isesipredishithini okufanele umuntu asibuyekeze, futhi eminye isaphunyuka.
problem.crm: Uyayilandelela imibuzo, kodwa eminye isaphunyuka ngaphambi kokuba ibe yimisebenzi.

pipeline.fix: Uhlelo lokuthengisa olukhombisa wonke umbuzo kusukela kumlayezo wokuqala kuze kube umsebenzi owinile, nesinyathelo esilandelayo nenani lawo.

tasks.problem: Ukulandelela kuncike ku-{{tools}}. Uma umuntu ematasa noma engekho, izinto ziyaphuthelwa.
tasks.fix: Imisebenzi enezinsuku zokugcina, izinhlu zokuhlola nezikhumbuzo, enikezwe umuntu ofanele ukuze kungabikho okuncike enkumbulweni.

documents.problem: Izilinganiso nama-invoyisi kwenziwa ku-{{tools}}: kubhalwa ngesandla, kunikezwa izinombolo ngesandla, futhi kunzima ukukulandelela.
documents.fix: Izilinganiso ezisezingeni eliphezulu ngemizuzu ezishintsha zibe ama-invoyisi ngokuchofoza kanye, ne-VAT, izinombolo nophawu lwakho kwenziwe kwakho.

problem.rarely: Izinkokhelo ezephuzile azivamile, kodwa akukho okuzibhekile, ngakho enye ingahlala izinyanga.
problem.manual: Ulandela abakhokha sekwephuzile wena, ucingo noma umlayezo owodwa ngesikhathi. Kudla amahora nezingxoxo ezingakhululekile.
problem.remember: Abakhokha sekwephuzile balandelwa kuphela uma ukhumbula, ngakho imali oyisebenzele isalokhu ingakhokhwa.
problem.automatic: Izinkokhelo ziyalandelelwa, kodwa kunzima ukubona ngokushesha ukuthi ubani okukweleta malini.

payments.fix: Bona ngokushesha ukuthi ubani okukweletayo, bese uvumela izikhumbuzo ezizenzakalelayo zilandelele ama-invoyisi asedlulelwe yisikhathi.

high.label: Uhleleke kakhulu

high.body: Akudingeki ukuthi ushintshe ngokushesha indlela osebenza ngayo. Uma ufuna konke kube ndawonye, i-{{name}} isengasiza, kodwa usuvele wenza kahle.

toolsCost.some: Angu-{{loose}} kuwo angamathuluzi axhunywe kancane kuphela, ngakho ezinye izinto zisakopishwa ngesandla: kususwa amaphuzu angu-{{points}}. Izinhlelo ezifana ne-CRM noma uhlelo lwama-invoyisi azikubalelwa kabi.
toolsCost.manual: Angu-{{loose}} kuwo angamathuluzi ongakopisha phakathi kwawo imininingwane ngesandla, ngakho izinto ziwela phakathi: kususwa amaphuzu angu-{{points}}. Izinhlelo ezifana ne-CRM noma uhlelo lwama-invoyisi azikubalelwa kabi.
toolsCost.unsure: Angu-{{loose}} kuwo angamathuluzi angahlangene, futhi awuqiniseki ukuthi yini ekopishwa phakathi kwawo, ngakho izinto zingawela phakathi: kususwa amaphuzu angu-{{points}}. Izinhlelo ezifana ne-CRM noma uhlelo lwama-invoyisi azikubalelwa kabi.

report.toolsFine: Leli yinani elilawulekayo. Ukuligcina kanjalo kuyazuzisa.
report.noGaps: Azikho izikhala ezinkulu ezitholakele. Wenze kahle.
report.how: Kuwukulinganisela, hhayi isithembiso, okusekelwe ezimpendulweni zakho kuphela. Isilinganiso ngasinye noma i-invoyisi kuthatha imizuzu engu-8 kuya ku-25 kuye ngokuthi kwenziwa kuphi, uma kuqhathaniswa nemizuzu engu-{{ygt}} kuya ku-{{lowYgt}} nge-{{name}}. Ukulandela i-invoyisi ephuzile ngesandla kuthatha cishe imizuzu engu-{{chase}}. Ukukopisha phakathi kwamathuluzi angahlangene kudla amahora afika ku-{{switching}} ngenyanga umuntu ngamunye ethuluzini ngalinye ngaphezu kwamabili, kancane uma amathuluzi akho exhunywe kancane futhi akudli lutho uma esebenzisana; okunye ukukopisha kuyasala nange-{{name}}. Ukubheka izinto kubalwa ngokwehlukile, ngakho awukho umzuzu obalwa kabili. Isikhathi sokubheka sikhula nenani labantu abenza umsebenzi wokuphatha, kodwa kancane kunethimba. Isiqongo sobubanzi yisikhathi sakho manje kususwa isikhathi esilinganiselwe nge-{{name}}; okuphansi kucabanga ukuthi udlulisela cishe ingxenye, ngemizuzu engu-{{lowYgt}} umqulu ngamunye. Ithuluzi ngalinye elingahlangene ngaphezu kuka-{{ok}} lidla amaphuzu afika ku-2, futhi amaphuzu asuka ku-0 aye ku-100.
report.trialTitle: Usukulungele ukwenza ukuqhuba ibhizinisi lakho kube lula?
report.trialBody: Usubonile lapho izinqubo zakho zingathuthuka khona. Zama i-{{name}} mahhala izinsuku ezingu-{{days}} ubeke konke endaweni eyodwa. Akudingeki ikhadi, ungakhansela noma nini.
report.worthNote: Ngenani lakho lehora. Leli yinani lesikhathi esikhululiwe, hhayi imali eyengeziwe eqinisekisiwe noma imali ongayonga. Imiphumela yakho incike ekutheni umsebenzi wakho omningi kangakanani owudlulisela kuyo.
report.toolsConnected: Uthe amathuluzi akho ayasebenzisana, ngakho inani lamathuluzi alikudleli amaphuzu.
report.rangeHigh: Amahora angu-{{hours}} uma udlulisela konke lokhu ku-{{name}}.

prospects.name: Igama noma igama lebhizinisi
prospects.addNote: Amakhasimende angaba khona awayitholi imikhankaso yakho aze avume ukuzwa kuwe.
prospects.lawNote: Umthetho waseNingizimu Afrika (i-POPIA) ukuvumela ukuthi uthumele ukumaketha kumakhasimende angaba khona kuphela uma esevumile. Maka "Uvumile ukumaketha" uma umuntu ethi yebo, noma uthumele isimemo sesikhathi esisodwa ukuze ubabuze. Bonke abavumayo bajoyina izithameli zemikhankaso yakho.
prospects.emptyHint: Engeza abantu namabhizinisi ofuna ukuwazuza. Amakhasimende angaba khona avela kumapayipi wakho naku-Discovery nawo avela lapha.
prospects.invitedOn: Isimemo sithunyelwe ngo-{{date}}. Silinde impendulo yabo.
prospects.declinedHint: Bathe cha noma bazikhipha, ngakho ngeke bathole ama-imeyili okumaketha.
prospects.agreeIntro: Bhala ukuthi u-{{name}} uvume kanjani ukuzwa kuwe. Kucacise: kuwubufakazi bakho uma umuntu ebuza.
prospects.howAgreedHint: Isibonelo: uthe yebo ocingweni ngomhla ka-29 Okthoba.
prospects.inviteMessage:
Sawubona {name},

Ngikubhalela ngisuka ku-{{company}}. Singathanda ukwabelana nawe ngezindaba eziwusizo, amathiphu neminikelo ngezikhathi ezithile.

Ungathanda ukuzwa kithina? Thepha u-"Yes, keep me posted" ngezansi. Uma kungenjalo, akunankinga nhlobo.
prospects.inviteOnce: Ungabuza u-{{email}} kanye kuphela. Impendulo yabo ibhalwa ngokuzenzakalela uma bethepha u-Yebo noma u-Cha.
prospects.subject: Isihloko
prospects.messageHint: Sebenzisa u-{name} egameni labo lokuqala. Buza ukuthi bangathanda yini ukuzwa kuwe, ugcine iminikelo kuze kube yilapho bethi yebo.
prospects.inviteAdds: Sengeza inkinobho ethi "Yes, keep me posted", isixhumanisi esithi "No thanks" nomugqa othi "We won't email you again unless you say yes."

consent.title: Ingabe i-YGT ingakuthumelela amathiphu, izindaba neminikelo?
consent.body: Ngezikhathi ezithile: izindlela zokonga isikhathi, izici ezintsha neminikelo ekhethekile. Kuphela uma uthi yebo, futhi ungakumisa noma nini kuphrofayela yakho.
consent.savedYes: Siyabonga! Ungakushintsha lokhu kuphrofayela yakho noma nini.
